create.name: Kyle Cease
create.bio:
Kyle Cease spent years as a stand-up comedian, with two Comedy Central specials and many film and television roles, before leaving comedy to become a transformational teacher. He still uses humour as a way in, but his work now centres on helping people drop the roles and expectations they perform for others and trust the self that is already there. He writes about this in The Illusion of Money, which looks at how the chase for money stands in for a deeper longing to feel safe, and in his earlier bestseller I Hope I Screw This Up.

His main teaching space is Infinite Expansion, an online membership with live weekly calls, guided meditations and what he calls Hot Seats, in which he works through one person's pattern in front of the group, together with a large library of past events and courses. He also offers short self-paced courses and private one-to-one video sessions, and he has filled large theatres for live events. His YouTube channel has years of free talks on surrender, forgiveness, self-worth and letting go of old identities.

books.title: The Illusion of Money: Why Chasing Money Is Stopping You from Receiving It
books.author: Kyle Cease
books.description: Argues that our fixation on money, and the fear of not having enough, is often a longing to feel safe, and shows how loosening that grip frees creativity and lets abundance arrive more naturally.

courses.title: Infinite Expansion Membership
courses.description: His online membership: live calls every week with meditations and Hot Seats, a vault of more than a thousand hours of replays, and over a dozen courses. The first month is free.

courses.title: 1-on-1 Session with Kyle Cease
courses.description: A private 55-minute video call with Kyle to look directly at a pattern or turning point in your life. The session is recorded for you to keep; multi-session series are also offered.

free_resources.title: The Illusion of Money (documentary)
free_resources.description: His full-length documentary on money, fear and receiving, free to watch after signing up with an email address.
